description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Balthier], [Apex Element of Treachery Damage Tracker] and [Apex Element of Treachery Level]

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Balthier
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Element of Treachery (0~2), removed after using Apex Element of Treachery two times

description.name: Apex Element of Treachery Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Element of Treachery level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Balthier]

description.name: Apex Element of Treachery Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Element of Treachery level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Balthier]
